exitCriteria: Two independent reviewers submit signed scorecards.
No critical defect is accepted as usable by both reviewers.
Critical software findings are reproducible from model and rule evidence.
limitations.statement: Two independent professional reviews, usable/not-usable agreement, and finding reproducibility are still pending.

evidence.source: Validation program scope and project review notes

exitCriteria: Appointed professionals verify the current site and governing requirements.
Authority-specific corrections are recorded against a project revision.
A signed issue decision is stored with the delivered package.
limitations.statement: Survey, jurisdictional code, fire/life-safety, accessibility, structural, MEP, and authority sign-off remain outside automated release evidence.

exitCriteria: Site and authority evidence is complete.
A separately approved issue package is generated and archived.
limitations.statement: Repository drawing packages remain preliminary planning and coordination aids, not construction or permit drawings.
